about.description: Open-source AI job search agent and job finder: scan job boards, score each job 1-5 against your CV before you apply, tailor an ATS-friendly resume and cover letter, get interview prep and a job application tracker. It helps you fill in each application; you press Submit. Runs locally in your AI coding CLI (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and more).

name: career-ops v1.37.0: Worth Your Time
body:
<!-- co:release-notes:career-ops-v1.37.0 -->
This release is about knowing what is still worth your time: postings you are tracking get checked for you, and every report opens with its verdict. The dashboard work (interview prep, cover-letter drafts, row comparison) ships in web-v0.15.0.

### Highlights

- **Is it still open?** `check-liveness.mjs --tracker` checks the postings behind your open tracker rows, and `--discard-expired` moves the Evaluated ones that closed to Discarded when you add `--apply` (it is a dry run otherwise), by @mbrow190 (#5177, #5241). When you find a posting by hand that the scan missed, `coverage-check` explains why, by @IaroslavMazur (#4849).
- **Reports that lead with the call.** Every report now opens with a Verdict block, by @rubicon (#3960). Block G gains Signal 18, recruiter identity verification, by @stdOWL (#5080), and the fact gate reads German count claims, by @duathron (#5074). Signals 8 to 17 now load only when their trigger holds, so evaluations read a shorter prompt, by @mbrow190 (#5229).
- **More places to look, in your language.** A Google provider that reads the first results page only, as robots.txt allows, and an opt-in Ashby embed source, by @kellymmcgrath (#4078, #4298). Kalibrr and Tech in Asia for Southeast Asia, by @rafifshaf-fun (#4420). Platsbanken, Sweden's national job board, by @gdut4140 (#5069). `preferred_languages` keeps the version of a posting in the language you apply in, by @ilyakanevskiy (#5285, with #4789, #5044, #5260, #5264).
- **Your setup.** Follow-ups can be turned off, by @mbrow190 (#5164). An opt-in local LaTeX installer so the LaTeX path compiles out of the box, by @CaptainCo0L (#5133). The Nix dev shell works on a fresh NixOS clone, by @asinglesprinkle (#5073).

### Security

- **providers:** a literal private IP host (such as `http://127.0.0.1/`) is now refused on the direct path too, not only behind a proxy (GHSA-jh4g-g3vm-m943). Reported by @gtyree, who also stopped the full ATS sweep from piling up thousands of idle connections in this release (#4841).

### Updating

Your agent offers this update at the start of your next session. If it doesn't, run this once in your career-ops folder:

```
node update-system.mjs apply --confirm
```

Your CV, profile, tracker and reports are not touched.

### Thank you

This release carries 263 pull requests from 61 people, 22 of them contributing for the first time.
